mapper.select: SELECT case_id, reporter_id, request_id, ticket_id, match_id, payload_hash, evidence_kind, state, review_connection, review_ref, disposition_code, created_at FROM w16_report_case WHERE reporter_id=#{reporterId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO w16_report_case(case_id, reporter_id, request_id, ticket_id, match_id, payload_hash, evidence_kind, state, review_connection, review_ref, disposition_code, created_at) VALUES(#{caseId}, #{reporterId}, #{requestId}, #{ticketId}, #{matchId}, #{payloadHash}, #{evidenceKind}, #{state}, #{reviewConnection}, #{reviewRef,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dispositionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt})
